_design_note: Neutral gate and mutation descriptions. No raw Betti numbers, no threshold values in candidate texts. PSE tags (abort_outcome, quarantine_outcome, recalibrate_outcome, hold_outcome, emit_outcome, boundary_gate, replay_gate, truth_gate, adapter_gate, betti_shift_exceeded, pd_distance_exceeded, silent_mutation, I08_violation, valid_proof, passes_guard) are the only reliable signal. Name-trap: Quarantine sounds correct when TruthGate failed, but BoundaryGate failure takes priority in outcome_kind() — the outcome is Abort. A mutation with a proof that registers a Betti shift above AllowedShift is still rejected; a mutation with no proof at all is an I-08 silent mutation spec violation.

cases.title: TptMtlGateReport: BoundaryGate fails — what is the correct outcome_kind and recovery?

tpt_mtl_context.description: TptMtlGateReport with boundary=false and truth=false (and axis=false). outcome_kind() evaluates gates in strict priority order: (1) !boundary || !replay → Abort; (2) !truth → Quarantine; (3) !adapter || !axis || !micro_lift || !carrier → Recalibrate; (4) all_passed && matrix && emission → Emit; (5) else → Hold. BoundaryGate is the first priority check and its failure policy is FailurePolicy::Abort. The TruthGate and AxisGate failures are real but superseded.

events.message: BoundaryGate=FAIL (source_boundary not in window input_refs), TruthGate=FAIL (2 unresolved contradictions), AxisGate=FAIL (axis mixing without TranslationProof)

candidates.text: Outcome variant signalling a hard boundary violation that terminates the current TPT-MTL pipeline run. Produced when the BoundaryGate or ReplayGate fails, independently of all other gate results. No bundle is emitted.

Reads the BoundaryGate diagnostics from the TptMtlGateReport. Compares each declared source_boundary hash in the RunDescriptor against the window's input_refs list and boundary_ref field to identify which boundary is missing.

Verifies that every source_boundary declared in TptMtlRunDescriptor appears in the PhaseSpaceWindow's input_refs or as its boundary_ref. Determines whether the mismatch is a missing hash or a misconfigured boundary declaration.

Outcome variant that isolates a pipeline run containing open critical contradictions in the reinterpreted claims. Applied when the TruthGate fails and unresolved contradictions are present in the ReinterpretationReport.
candidates._trap: Quarantine applies when only TruthGate fails. BoundaryGate failure takes priority in outcome_kind() and produces Abort before the TruthGate check is reached.

candidates.text: Outcome variant that requests resubmission with adjusted configuration when adapter, axis, micro-lift or carrier gates fail. Allows the pipeline to self-correct without aborting.
candidates._trap: Recalibrate applies to adapter/axis/micro_lift/carrier failures — priority branch 3. BoundaryGate failure triggers branch 1 (Abort) before branch 3 is reached.

candidates.text: Outcome variant that suspends bundle emission and holds the pipeline state for re-evaluation when partial gate failures do not trigger a higher-priority branch.
candidates._trap: Hold is the fallback (branch 5). BoundaryGate failure triggers Abort at branch 1 — Hold is never reached.

candidates.text: Outcome variant produced only when all gates pass, including MatrixGate and EmissionGate. Causes the TptMtlBundle to be released downstream.
Resolves the open contradictions flagged in the ReinterpretationReport by assigning an authoritative verdict to each contested claim pair and updating evidence_refs.
candidates._trap: Resolving TruthGate contradictions does not fix the BoundaryGate failure. The Abort outcome is determined before TruthGate is reached.

candidates.text: Provides a TranslationProof for the axis-mixing detected by the AxisGate, declaring the permitted coordinate bridge between axis origins.
Modifies the BoundaryGate configuration to accept missing source_boundary hashes by expanding the set of allowed boundary_ref values.

correct_next_actions: inspect_boundary_violation to find which source_boundary is missing from window
audit_source_boundary_refs to determine mismatch type (hash vs declaration)
rejected_false_paths: Quarantine (TruthGate policy — superseded by BoundaryGate at priority branch 1)
Recalibrate (adapter/axis/carrier policy — superseded by BoundaryGate at branch 1)
Hold (fallback branch — never reached when boundary fails)

cases.title: TopologyGuard mutation audit — which mesh mutations satisfy Δβ ∈ AllowedShift ∧ W_p ≤ θ_PD?

tpt_mtl_context.guard_rule: Δβ_i ∈ AllowedShift_i for all dimensions AND W_p(PD_old, PD_new) ≤ θ_PD; every mutation MUST produce a TopologyGuardProof (Invariant I-08)
tpt_mtl_context.description: Five mesh mutations were submitted for TopologyGuard evaluation. Invariant I-08 requires every mutation to produce a registered TopologyGuardProof. The guard checks two criteria: (1) the per-dimension Betti shift Δβ must lie within AllowedShift; (2) the Wasserstein distance W_p between the old and new persistence diagrams must not exceed θ_PD. A mutation that satisfies both criteria and has a registered proof is a valid guard-pass. A mutation whose Betti shift exceeds AllowedShift in any dimension is rejected. A mutation whose persistence diagram distance exceeds θ_PD is rejected. A mutation that produces no TopologyGuardProof at all violates I-08 regardless of the structural outcome.

events.message: check_topology_guard called for 5 mutations, evaluating Δβ ∈ AllowedShift AND W_p <= θ_PD
3 mutations passed guard, 2 failed: betti_shift_exceeded on mutation_delta, pd_distance_exceeded on mutation_epsilon

candidates.text: Simplex insertion that attaches a new triangular face to an existing boundary edge. A TopologyGuardProof was produced and registered for this mutation. The proof records that both the per-dimension Betti vector change and the persistence diagram Wasserstein distance satisfy the configured mesh policy.

Edge collapse that merges a pair of adjacent high-degree vertices, reducing local mesh density. A TopologyGuardProof was produced and registered. The proof confirms the Betti shift falls within the allowed range for each homology dimension and the persistence diagram distance is below the configured threshold.

Facet subdivision that splits a high-variance triangle into two sub-triangles aligned with the primary phase axis. A TopologyGuardProof was produced and registered, with all guard dimensions within the mesh policy bounds.
Vertex insertion that bridges two previously disconnected mesh components by adding a shared boundary node. A TopologyGuardProof was produced and registered for this mutation.
candidates._trap: Bridging disconnected components changes the zeroth Betti number (connected components) by an amount that exceeds AllowedShift[0]. The proof is present but records a failed guard check.

candidates.text: Seam re-stitching that reconnects two boundary seam segments with an updated incidence table. A TopologyGuardProof was produced and registered for this mutation.
candidates._trap: Re-stitching the seam produces a persistence diagram whose Wasserstein distance to the pre-mutation diagram exceeds θ_PD. The proof is present but the pd_distance check failed.

candidates.text: Coordinate relabeling that reassigns vertex indices across the mesh to restore a canonical ordering after a failed triangulation attempt.
candidates._trap: No TopologyGuardProof was produced for this mutation. Invariant I-08 requires every mesh mutation to produce a registered proof — absence of proof is a spec violation regardless of whether the structural change would have passed.

candidates.text: Modifies the AllowedShift configuration in MeshPolicy to increase the permitted per-dimension Betti shift, allowing mutation_delta to pass the guard.
Increases the max_pd_wasserstein parameter in MeshPolicy so that the persistence diagram distance recorded for mutation_epsilon falls within the new threshold.
Removes the TopologyGuardProof entries from the MeshHolo proof record and re-runs the triangulation pipeline from the BuildWindow step without re-evaluating the guard.
candidates._trap: Removing guard proofs violates Invariant I-05 (Trace, Evidence, Gate-History and Proofs MUST NOT disappear). Re-running without evaluating the guard violates I-08.

candidates.text: Sets topology_guard_proofs to an empty list and marks the TopologyGate as passed in the TptMtlGateReport without evaluating any mutation.

correct_next_actions: mutation_alpha passes guard (proof registered, Δβ and W_p both within policy)
mutation_beta passes guard (proof registered, Δβ and W_p both within policy)
mutation_gamma passes guard (proof registered, all dimensions within policy)
rejected_false_paths: mutation_delta (proof present but Betti shift exceeds AllowedShift[0])
mutation_epsilon (proof present but W_p(PD_old, PD_new) > θ_PD)
mutation_zeta (no TopologyGuardProof — Invariant I-08 silent mutation violation)
